_about: The interface's own words in English, which every other catalog falls back to (ADR 0141, docs/languages.md).
language.label: Language
profile.title: Your Profile
profile.guest: You are playing as a guest.
profile.here_note: The signed-in players who have been here in the last few minutes, by their usernames.
profile.asked_you: {name} has asked to be your friend
settings.guest: You play as a guest in this browser. {signin}
settings.guest_signup: You play as a guest in this browser. {signin} or {signup} to keep your games on every device.
settings.ratings_note: A question mark means the rating is provisional. You appear on a game's leaderboard after 5 rated games against at least 3 different people.
settings.make_account_note: Email notifications, direct messages and the global chat are for signed-in players now. This browser confirmed an email address already, so it can become your account at once: choose a username and a password, and your games, and your turn mail, carry on.
settings.name: Name
settings.name_note: Saved in this browser. Games you already joined keep the name you used in them.
settings.accounts_only_html: Email notifications are for signed-in players: sign in to have {brand} mail you when it is your turn.
settings.email_note: Only used for the turn notices you ask for. {brand} mails a link to confirm the address first, and never shows it to other players.
settings.notify: Send me an email when it is my turn
settings.notify_note: Applies to games you join or open from now on; you can change it for each game in its options.
settings.notify_off: Email notifications are not set up on this server. What you choose here is kept in this browser for when they are.
settings.not_an_address: That does not look like an email address.
settings.not_sent: The address could not be sent.
settings.resent: A new confirmation was sent to {address}.
settings.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {address}. Open it and press Confirm (look in the spam folder too).
settings.forgotten: Your address was deleted from the server.
settings.friend_mail: Email me when somebody sends me a friend request
settings.friend_invites: Let other players invite me to games
settings.presence_note_html: Off, you look offline to your friends and are not in Here now. Friends cannot start a message or call with you, but you can write to them, and they can reply.
settings.no_badges: No badges yet. Win a game against another player for your first.
settings.player_page_html: Your player page, as other players see it.
badge.later: The others see it when the game ends.
bar.no_games: No games going. Pick one in the Games tab to start.
bar.help_news: Help, with changes you have not seen
call.not_made: The call could not be made.
call.dropped: The call ended: you joined another one.
call.not_connected: The call could not be connected.
call.no_mic: The microphone could not be opened.
dm.add_label: The handle of a player to add
dm.invite_game: The game to invite them to
dm.kept: Messages reach friends who are online, and are kept for a couple of hours on the server and nowhere else.
dm.add_somebody: Add somebody by their handle to play and talk with them.
dm.is_offline: {name} is offline. You can still invite them to a game.
dm.pick: Pick a friend to write to them.
dm.no_game: You have no game to invite them to
games.remove_waiting: Remove {title} from your list? You keep your seat, and its link still brings you back.
games.ends_for_all: This ends the game for everyone at the table.
games.counts_loss: This is a rated game, and counts as a loss.
games.resign_confirm: Resign from {title} and remove it from your list?
games.resign_failed: Could not resign from that game.
games.resign_remove: Resign and remove from this list
guest.open_link: Open this link on the other device (it is copied), or paste the key there:
guest.copy_by_hand: Copy the link or the key by hand.
guest.adopted: This browser is that guest now: its games are under Active Games, and this browser's own came along.
guest.rotated: This browser has a new key. The old one, wherever you copied it, no longer works; your games are still yours.
guest.discard: Start over as a new guest
guest.discard_confirm: Start over as a new guest? This browser loses its seats: the games you play now stay with the old guest, which nobody can reach again.
guest.discarded: This browser is a new guest from its next game on.
guest.about: Your guest key is what makes your seats yours. Copy it to your phone or another browser to carry on your games there. Anybody with the key can play as you.
guest.no_key: You get a guest key to copy once you make or join your first game. If you have one from another device, use it here.
guest.use: Use a guest key from another device
guest.more: If your key got out, or to start again
guest.title: Move to Another Device
notify.stopped: {address} used the unsubscribe link: {brand} will not email it.
notify.confirm: Confirm {address}: open the link we emailed you.
notify.sent_from: Sent from {from}. Add it to your contacts so it reaches your inbox.
notify.insecure: This connection is not encrypted: your email address could be seen by others on the network. Use an https:// address.
notify.not_your_seat: Only the browser that joined this seat can change this.
notify.every_turn: Every turn, unless this game is open
notify.set_address: Set your email address in your {profile} first.
notify.then_come_back: {status} Then come back here, or turn it on from your profile.
notify.not_read: The setting could not be read.
notify.not_saved: The setting could not be saved.
notify.saved_off: Saved. No email for this game.
notify.offer: {brand} can tell you when it's your turn or you earn a badge, while you're in another tab.
voice.label: Voice chat
voice.deafen_title: Stop hearing the others (this also mutes you)
voice.in_game: In the voice chat of game {code}

voice.unsupported: This browser cannot do voice chat (no microphone or WebRTC support).
voice.blocked: The microphone was blocked. Allow it for this site in the browser (the icon in the address bar), then try again.
voice.no_mic: No microphone was found. Plug one in or choose another in the browser's settings.
voice.mic_busy: The microphone is in use by another program.
voice.left: You left the voice chat of this game: you are in another call.
voice.talk_here: Talk in this game instead (you are in the voice chat of game {code})
voice.in_settings: In the voice chat: its settings
voice.elsewhere: You are in the voice chat of {game}.
